sensitivity_is: Illustrative bounded error arithmetic; NOT measured process capability or tolerance qualification

sensitivity.name: 13.02 housing / exact 13.00 bearing
sensitivity.meaning: An illustrative 0.2 mm diameter error can consume the entire nominal seat clearance. Bearing OD tolerance is omitted, not known to be zero.

sensitivity.name: One side of closure tab
sensitivity.meaning: Two independently displaced faces can jam despite a nominal 0.2 mm per-side gap.

sensitivity.name: Lid seam
sensitivity.meaning: Positive residual gap under these assumed errors only; body warp, screw preload and seals are not included.

sensitivity.name: Motor M3x6 insertion margin to 2.8 mm depth
sensitivity.meaning: Nominal engagement is 2.5 mm; illustrative range is 2.25..2.75 mm. Measure before assembly; these are not vendor screw tolerances.

sensitivity.name: Rotor M2x5 insertion margin to 2.8 mm depth
sensitivity.meaning: The assumed errors allow bottoming out: nominal 2.65 mm insertion becomes 2.45..2.85 mm. Select actual screws and control/measure the metal seat.
